types.title: Render
types.doc: An immutable source render recipe with ordered effects, materialized only when its audio output is consumed or explicitly built.

types.title: Region
types.doc: A stretch of audio marked inside a loop or a take (the part between two points), carried on until a region-merge block turns it back into audio. It only connects to another region port.

types.title: MIDI sequence
types.doc: A bounded Standard MIDI File event stream with original ticks and event order.

types.title: Data
types.doc: Structured data such as style or external values.

types.title: Control
types.doc: A number over time that comes out of a sound or a curve and steers a parameter: a level from 0 to 1 (control), or a value in a unit (control<Hz>, control<dB>, ...). A control only connects to a parameter that can be automated, never to audio or MIDI; a control with a unit only to a parameter in that unit.

types.title: Any
types.doc: Matches every type except render. Used by groups.

compatibility: A source port connects to an input port when the types are equal or either side is "any", except render only connects to render.
